export_controls.text:
It was great to meet NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang on Tuesday! We had an excellent conversation about how the U.S. can lead the world in the AI race.

In less than a year, @nvidia is now manufacturing the most advanced chips for AI right here in the U.S., a huge win for American based manufacturing.

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses U.S. AI leadership and domestic chip manufacturing, not overseas access restrictions or enforcement.
deepseek.confidence_reason: Domestic chip production is explicitly irrelevant to export controls under the rubric.
